title: Summer Notes 7/28/26
textContent:
Section 1
In a loving, nurturing environment, St. Martha School guides each student to develop his or her unique ability and potential through prayer, study and service.

[1] TMARTHAJ
PARISH & SCHOOL [ig

A Message from Mrs. Konopaska
I hope you are enjoying a wonderful summer! It has been a busy and productive one here at St. Martha as construction continues to move forward. While we are excited about the progress, the project has brought about changes to timelines and plans. As a result, some details may continue to evolve as we prepare for the start of the school year. Please know that our students are always at the heart of every decision. I will continue to advocate for the best opportunities and learning environment for each child. As we begin the new school year, I ask for your grace, patience, and flexibility as we navigate any unexpected changes together. Change isn't always easy, but I am confident that, as a school community, we will work through it together. It is an honor to serve St. Martha. I am grateful for the opportunity to partner with our families, support our dedicated staff, and help our students grow academically, spiritually, and personally. Thank you for your continued trust and support. I look forward to welcoming everyone back soon! - Mrs. Konopaska

Important Note
Mrs. Konopaska is out of the office July 31st- August 10th and will return and emails or calls when she returns.

26-27 Calendar: Important Upcoming Dates
Building Update: The Parish & School will be closed until Thursday, July 30th August 20 - Meet the Miracles & Supply Drop-Off August 24 - First Day of School (Half Day): August 24, 25, 26 Kindergarten: Half Days September 9 - 4 YO Preschoolers begin September 10 - 3 YO Preschoolers begin There is always the possibility of a change throughout the school year. The building will remain closed until Friday, July 31. Masses on Wednesday, July 29 and Thursday, July 30 will take place outside the narthex door (north entrance) of the church building. Adoration on Wednesday and confessions both Wednesday and Thursday are cancelled.

26-27 Academic Calendar - Subject to Change
Please review the calendar for updates made in July.
26-27 Academic Calendar (9).pdf

Meet the Miracles
St. Martha Catholic School is excited to welcome all families, new and veteran to Meet the Miracles ! This special event is a wonderful opportunity for current families, new families, teachers, and staff to come together, mix and mingle, and celebrate the beginning of a new school year. We are especially excited to welcome our many new families joining us across Preschool–8th Grade and look forward to helping them feel at home in our St. Martha community. Meet the Miracles will take place on Thursday, August 20th from 5:30-7pm at the St. Martha Playground Area . Families can enjoy hot dogs, chips, lemonade, and cookies. Feel free to bring a blanket or chairs if you would like a place to sit and visit. Fr. Ryan, Mrs. Konopaska, and the St. Martha teachers and staff will be there and are looking forward to welcoming everyone! An RSVP is not required, but it is helpful for planning purposes. Please click the link below if you plan (or hope) to attend:
Meet the Miracles RSVP & Volunteer Sign UP

FACTS update information from the Diocese of Lansing
We’re pleased to let you know that the FACTS system update for the Diocese of Lansing has been successfully completed. Thank you for your patience throughout this transition. By bringing all diocesan schools together under a single district in FACTS , we have created a more consistent experience for families while improving communication, reporting, and administration across the Diocese—all while maintaining your student records and tuition information . What You Need to Do Access the New Family Portal Please begin using the updated Family Portal link: https://sis. factsmgt .com/ family-portal?DistrictCode= LANSING-DIO If you previously bookmarked the old Family Portal, please update your bookmark. Sign In Sign in using your existing email address/username and password. If prompted, follow the on-screen instructions to verify your account or reset your password. Verify Your Information After signing in, please take a moment to confirm that: All of your students appear in your account. Student information is accurate. Enrollment and tuition information appear as expected. If you notice anything that doesn't look correct—such as a missing student, duplicate record, or other issue—please contact your school office so we can assist you. Online Payments Online payments through the Family Portal are now available again. You may resume making payments online as usual. Any previously scheduled automatic payments will continue without interruption. Thank you again for your patience and partnership throughout this transition. We appreciate your support as we continue enhancing the experience for families across the Diocese of Lansing.

26-27 District Code Update:
Please use: LANSING-DIO
in place of STMS-MI
We encourage all families to try logging in to FACTS this
week. If you cannot login, please email Mrs. Farnsworth. If
you receive and error, please send a screenshot.

Summer Packets
Summer packets will be mailed August 4th. If you do not receive your packet, please contact Mrs. Farnsworth at: cfarnsworth@st-martha.org If you have recently updated your address, please update your information on FACTS before the end of the week. Packets returned to the school may be picked up by appointment only.

Important Update: New School Lunch Ordering Process
Starting this school year, Lansing Catholic will transition to monthly lunch ordering rather than daily orders. Ordering Deadline: Lunch orders must be placed on FACTS one week before the new month begins. Full instructions on how to order through FACTS will be included in your summer packet. Absences: If your student is sick or absent, their lunch order for that day will be removed and will not be charged. Emergency Meals: If a student forgets their lunch, we can add a last-minute order. Please note that this option is for emergencies only and cannot be used on a regular basis.

Acceptable Use Policy for Electronic Devices Chromebooks, and Technology
Please review our updated Acceptable Use Policy for Electronic Devices Chromebooks, and Technology. You will receive a form to sign in our summer packet. Coming soon: Parent & Student Handbook

Supply List
Supply lists are here! If you have any specific questions about supplies or what to bring, please reach out directly to your child's homeroom teacher.
PS-2nd Grade Supply List
Supply List PS-2.pdf
3rd-8th Grade Supply List
Supply List 3-8.pdf

Uniform Information
Maroon short sleeve polo shirts will be available as a new option for the 26-27 school year for K-8. Since this is a new additional option to our uniform collection, there will be some lead time before maroon polos are available for our school. Once they are available, they will be added to the website and I will notify families. This will only be available in short sleeves. Free shipping on order $50 and up. Use code: FREESHIP14

Spirit Wear is Back!
Our St. Martha School Spirit Wear Shop through Fabricated Customs is back! The shop will now remain open indefinitely , making it easy to grab your favorite gear anytime during the year. From cozy sweatshirts and stylish tees to fun options for both kids and adults , there’s something for everyone to show their St. Martha School pride!
